text_en: She is the book of the commandments of God, the law that endures forever. All who hold her fast will live, and those who forsake her will die.
text_cn: 她就是天主的诫命书，是永存的法律；凡遵守她的，必得生命；凡离弃她的，必要死亡。

text_en: Turn, O Jacob, and take her; walk toward the shining of her light.
text_cn: 雅各伯！你该悔悟，该争取她，该在她的光照下，向着光辉进发；

text_en: Do not give your glory to another, or your advantages to an alien people.
text_cn: 你不该将你的光荣给与他人，不要将你的特权让给异民。

text_en: Happy are we, O Israel, for we know what is pleasing to God.
text_cn: 以色列人，我们真有福！天主将所喜悦的，启示给我们了。

text_en: Take courage, my people, who perpetuate Israel’s name!
text_cn: 我的百姓，以色列的遗民啊！请你们鼓起勇气！

text_en: It was not for destruction that you were sold to the nations, but you were handed over to your enemies because you angered God.
text_cn: 你们被卖给外邦人，不是为被消灭，只是因为你们触怒了天主，你们才被交付给敌人；

text_en: For you provoked the one who made you by sacrificing to demons and not to God.
text_cn: 实在，你们触怒了你们的造主，因为你们给恶魔而不给天主献祭，

text_en: You forgot the everlasting God, who brought you up, and you grieved Jerusalem, who reared you.
text_cn: 忘了生养你们的永生的天主， 使养育你们的耶路撒冷悲伤，

text_en: For she saw the wrath that came upon you from God, and she said: Listen, you neighbors of Zion, God has brought great sorrow upon me;
text_cn: 她眼见天主的义怒降在你们身上，不由得说：“熙雍的邻邦！请你们听吧！天主给我招来了莫大的忧苦，

text_en: for I have seen the exile of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting brought upon them.
text_cn: 因为我看见我的儿女被放逐：这是永生者放逐他们。

text_en: With joy I nurtured them, but I sent them away with weeping and sorrow.
text_cn: 我曾在喜乐中，抚养了他们，如今却在痛苦悲伤中让他们离去。

text_en: Let no one rejoice over me, a widow and bereaved of many; I was left desolate because of the sins of my children, because they turned away from the law of God.
text_cn: 谁也不要对我这被众人遗弃的寡妇，幸灾乐祸！我孤苦伶仃，是为了我子女的罪恶，因为他们离弃了天主的法律；

text_en: They had no regard for his statutes; they did not walk in the ways of God’s commandments, or tread the paths his righteousness showed them.
text_cn: 他们没有认识他的规诫，没有履行天主诫命的道路，没有随从他正义纪律的路途。

text_en: Let the neighbors of Zion come; remember the capture of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting brought upon them.
text_cn: 熙雍的邻邦！请你们前来，怀念永生者放逐我儿女的事。

text_en: For he brought a distant nation against them, a nation ruthless and of a strange language, which had no respect for the aged and no pity for a child.
text_cn: 他从远方给他们引来了一个民族，是一个没有廉耻和言语不同的民族，不知敬老，也不知恤幼。

text_en: They led away the widow’s beloved sons, and bereaved the lonely woman of her daughters.
text_cn: 他们夺去了寡妇的爱子，使她丧失儿女，孤苦伶仃。

text_en: But I, how can I help you?
text_cn: 但是我又怎能援助你们呢？

text_en: For he who brought these calamities upon you will deliver you from the hand of your enemies.
text_cn: 只有给你们招来这些灾祸的那位，才能救你们脱离敌人的掌握。

text_en: Go, my children, go; for I have been left desolate.
text_cn: 去吧！孩子们，去吧！我该独自一个留下；

text_en: I have taken off the robe of peace and put on sackcloth for my supplication; I will cry to the Everlasting all my days.
text_cn: 我要脱去升平时的衣饰，穿上我哀祷的苦衣，一生不断向永生者呼号。

text_en: Take courage, my children, cry to God, and he will deliver you from the power and hand of the enemy.
text_cn: 孩子们！奋勇起来，向天主呼号吧！他必拯救你们脱离强权和敌人的掌握。

text_en: For I have put my hope in the Everlasting to save you, and joy has come to me from the Holy One, because of the mercy that will soon come to you from your everlasting savior.
text_cn: 我曾期望永生者拯救你们，圣者就给我带来喜乐，因为永生者，你们的救主，不久就要对你们施行仁慈。

text_en: For I sent you out with sorrow and weeping, but God will give you back to me with joy and gladness forever.
text_cn: 我曾含泪悲痛让你们离去，天主却快要以永远的喜乐和欢欣，将你们交还给我；

text_en: For as the neighbors of Zion have now seen your capture, so they soon will see your salvation by God, which will come to you with great glory and with the splendor of the Everlasting.
text_cn: 就如现在熙雍的邻邦看见你们被掳去，同样不久他们要见到你们的天主以绝大的光荣，和永恒的光辉赐给你们的救援。

text_en: My children, endure with patience the wrath that has come upon you from God. Your enemy has overtaken you, but you will soon see their destruction and will tread upon their necks.
text_cn: 孩子们！你们该忍受天主向你们发泄的忿怒。仇人迫害了你，但不久你将看见他们的没落和践踏他们的颈项。

text_en: My pampered children have traveled rough roads; they were taken away like a flock carried off by the enemy.
text_cn: 我娇贵的儿女被人掳去，沿着崎岖的道路前行，好似被仇人夺去的羊群。

text_en: Take courage, my children, and cry to God, for you will be remembered by the one who brought this upon you.
text_cn: 孩子们！奋勇起来，向天主呼号吧！因为使这事降到你们身上的那位，必要眷念你们。

text_en: For just as you were disposed to go astray from God, return with tenfold zeal to seek him.
text_cn: 从前你们心意昏愚，徘徊歧途，远离天主；如今却要十倍往昔，回转头来寻求天主，

text_en: For the one who brought these calamities upon you will bring you everlasting joy with your salvation.
text_cn: 因为给你们招来这些灾祸的那位，要拯救你们，赐给你们永远的喜乐。

text_en: Take courage, O Jerusalem, for the one who named you will comfort you.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷！请你鼓起勇气！给你起名的那位，必要抚慰你。

text_en: Wretched will be those who mistreated you and who rejoiced at your fall.
text_cn: 凡虐待过你，见你衰落而欣喜的，是有祸的；

text_en: Wretched will be the cities that your children served as slaves; wretched will be the city that received your offspring.
text_cn: 奴役你子女的，是有祸的；那收留过你子女的城邑，是有祸的；

text_en: For just as she rejoiced at your fall and was glad for your ruin, so she will be grieved at her own desolation.
text_cn: 因为她怎样见你衰落而欢欣，怎样见你灭亡而喜庆，她也要同样因自己的荒凉而哀伤。

text_en: I will take away her pride in her great population, and her insolence will be turned to grief.
text_cn: 我必夺去她因人烟稠密而有的繁荣，使她的夸耀化为哀伤，

text_en: For fire will come upon her from the Everlasting for many days, and for a long time she will be inhabited by demons.
text_cn: 因为必有长久不灭的火从永生者那里降在她身上，使她长期受恶魔的侵扰。

text_en: Look toward the east, O Jerusalem, and see the joy that is coming to you from God.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷！请你向东远眺，遥望由天主那里给你降来的喜乐。

text_en: Look, your children are coming, whom you sent away; they are coming, gathered from east and west, at the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of God.
text_cn: 看，离你远去的子女正在归来；奉圣者的命，他们由东方到西方，集合归来，因着天主的光荣，喜悦若狂。
